name: Movies Remastered (MRDb)
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Fetches fan edit metadata from the Movies Remastered Database (moviesremastered.com / MRDb), a community fanedit archive. No account required. Please use responsibly — a minimum 1-second delay between requests is enforced.
fixMatchHint: Enter a moviesremastered.com URL (e.g. https://www.moviesremastered.com/movieinfo.php?id=12179) or a bare MRDb numeric ID

background_tasks.description: Looks up MRDb metadata for fan edits that don't have it yet.

run_confirmation.title: Fetch MRDb metadata?
run_confirmation.message: Movies Remastered is a small community site. This task makes one HTTP request per fan edit with a minimum 1-second delay between each — on a large library this will take a long time. Please run this sparingly, not more than a few times per week.

background_tasks.description: Re-fetches MRDb metadata for all fan edits to pick up updated descriptions, ratings, and images.

run_confirmation.title: Re-sync all MRDb metadata?
run_confirmation.message: This will re-fetch MRDb metadata for every fan edit in your library. Movies Remastered is a small community site — each request has a minimum 1-second delay. On a large library this will take a very long time. Please use this sparingly.
